findings.text: the head-arm log's own first line names ccfd3d366631edd5d45850053a6ecfad02e2bd95 with the repaired test file in the working tree, while the manifest's after_suite.revision claims 8b53b16f and the log's mtime of 06:43 precedes that commit at 06:45:45, so a reader reconciling the manifest with its log finds a revision the log does not name; the substance holds, because my head arm at the committed head is 11 passed, but the receipt should name the tree it actually ran from.

the pin is never asserted to be the clock the classifier read, so a later refactor that keeps recovery._utc_seconds importable while classify_pointer observes a different clock leaves both derivations live and the comparison green with the boundary drift intact, which is the failure this run repaired; the derived ages are exactly 240 and 120 in logs/review-mutation-m2-shape-divergence.log, so an assertion on those ages would hold at this head and turn the pin into a measured fact.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit; 8b53b16f pins obligations._utc_now and recovery._utc_seconds to census.OBSERVED_AT at lines 78 and 79 and stamps the seeded manifest mtimes from the same instant at line 131, leaving the derivation to run end to end through classify_pointer, and d0bad626 appends the landing comment and the evidence anchor; neither commit touches a product path.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when is the named test green with its base failure retired, which my own scratch exports show: 11 passed EXIT=0 at d0bad6266ba25f9b2ba61f65a0347aa1830cf34b (logs/review-head-arm.log) against 1 failed, 10 passed at ccfd3d366631edd5d45850053a6ecfad02e2bd95 (logs/review-base-arm.log), the base failure being the single id tests/test_mcp_crew_obligations.py::test_obligations_view_returns_the_derived_items_unchanged and the head arm carrying no failure, so one failure is retired and zero are added.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal was to make tests/test_mcp_crew_obligations.py::test_obligations_view_returns_the_derived_items_unchanged pass on main by repairing whichever side is wrong, after first reproducing the failure at the dispatch base and naming the cause; the failure reproduced in my own scratch export of ccfd3d366631edd5d45850053a6ecfad02e2bd95 (1 failed, 10 passed, logs/review-base-arm.log) and the cause is a live clock rather than a divergence, because reckon/mcp.py:3789 hands back obligations_module.obligations(project, session) unchanged and each age is int(moment - terminal_seconds) with moment = recovery._utc_seconds() (reckon/crew/recovery.py:3531, consumed at :3800), so two derivations one second apart disagree by one on the same duty; the test asserted equality between two such derivations, so the test side was the wrong side and repairing it hides no product defect.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states the gate command and both arm results, names the three gate logs and the negative-control log, and its negative_control_note matches the log it names, where the reverted file reds the named test on the age drift 250 against 249; its after_suite.revision names 8b53b16f while the log it points at opened on ccfd3d36 with the repaired file in the working tree, and that log's mtime precedes the commit.
item_verdicts.write_paths: git show --stat reads 8b53b16f as one file, tests/test_mcp_crew_obligations.py, 14 insertions and 2 deletions, and d0bad626 as the plan section comment plus the evidence record, 22 insertions, three of the six paths the dispatch declared and no product source at all; no plan-version or plan-modified meta line appears in the plan hunk.

justifications.durability: the pin is measured to bind rather than assumed, since the ages the checker compares are exactly the seeded 240 and 120 (logs/review-mutation-m2-shape-divergence.log) where a live clock would read roughly 219000, and every clock on the assertion path routes through the two pinned names including drain's classify_pointer call; but the test never asserts that binding, so a refactor that keeps recovery._utc_seconds defined while classify_pointer observes elsewhere restores the boundary flake silently.
justifications.evidence: both arms are reproduced independently in scratch exports that print module.__file__ and cwd in their headers, and two divergence mutations I applied at the head red the named test (logs/review-mutation-m1-age-divergence.log for a one-second age divergence, logs/review-mutation-m2-shape-divergence.log for a dropped next_command), but the manifest's after_suite.revision does not match its own log's first line.
justifications.fit: the repair reuses the sibling fixture's vocabulary and its one-clock idea, since tests/test_crew_obligations.py:401 and :460 already pass now_seconds explicitly to classify_pointer, and differs only in idiom by monkeypatching the module global; the added comment explains the mechanism without plan, sprint or ticket labels.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the repair sits on the side the read code names, since reckon/mcp.py:3789 is a passthrough and neither commit touches a product file, and the failure was reproduced at the dispatch base before repair; the declared mutation reverts the file, which restores the reproduction rather than falsifying the new pin.
justifications.scope_discipline: git show --stat over 8b53b16f and d0bad626 lists only tests/test_mcp_crew_obligations.py, the plan comment block and the evidence record, all inside the six declared paths, and no plan-version or plan-modified meta line is touched.
